applications.name: Aoede
requirements: Needs the approved prebuilt-image or Rust/native dependency installer.
Requires Spotify Premium and Spotify credentials in addition to a Discord bot token.

applications.name: ATL Bot
requirements: Needs verified Prisma/native runtime compatibility and an initialized PostgreSQL database.
Configure NODE_CONFIG for the target Discord server; some upstream behavior is ATLauncher-specific.

applications.name: Bastion
requirements: Needs verified native audio dependencies, current configuration and command registration.
Check the current upstream database requirements instead of the older MongoDB Egg recipe.

applications.name: CorpBot.py
requirements: Needs settings_dict.json generation and its project-specific Python dependency installer.
The historical Python 3.8 claim is not a verified current compatibility range.

applications.name: Dynamica
requirements: Requires TOKEN and an existing prepared PostgreSQL database via POSTGRES_URL.
Requires the updated Agent pnpm capability. No database is provisioned automatically.
The optional HTTP API is not exposed by the outbound-only installer. Discord login has not been smoke-tested.

applications.name: fragbot
requirements: Needs a Go build installer and verified application configuration handling.

applications.name: JMusicBot
applications.description: Discord music bot distributed as a Java application.
requirements: Needs a verified release JAR downloader, Java runtime and config.txt editing.

applications.name: JTS3ServerMod
requirements: Needs the verified official release downloader, Java runtime and configuration file editing.
Requires connection settings and credentials for a TeamSpeak ServerQuery account.

applications.name: Muse
requirements: The historical upstream URL must be resolved and its current distribution verified before enabling installation.
Needs verified audio dependencies and application credentials.

applications.name: parkertron
requirements: Needs a Go/CGO installer with Tesseract OCR and Leptonica.
Needs YAML/JSON configuration editing.

applications.name: PhantomBot
applications.description: Java-powered Twitch bot with a web administration panel.
requirements: Needs the Java/prebuilt release installer and persistent configuration.
Needs port 25000 and Twitch OAuth setup through the application web panel.

applications.name: pixel-bot
requirements: Needs config/config.json and plugin settings editing.
Upstream documents an old development Python/discord.py stack; compatibility needs testing.

applications.name: Red-DiscordBot
requirements: Needs a Red-specific pip installer, instance setup and redbot executable startup.
Requires additional system dependencies; the generic Python entrypoint is insufficient.

applications.name: Ree6
requirements: Needs a Java/release installer and config.yml editing.
Additional application integrations may require API credentials and networking.

applications.name: SinusBot
applications.description: Music bot for TeamSpeak 3 and Discord.
requirements: Needs the approved native/prebuilt image installer, persistent data and HTTP port allocation.
Verify the upstream licensing terms before hosting commercial instances.

applications.name: SogeBot
applications.description: Twitch chat and streaming companion bot.
requirements: Needs native dependency verification, Twitch OAuth setup and an HTTP port allocation.

applications.name: VoiceTwine
requirements: Needs pnpm, native dependency verification and an initialized MariaDB database.
Needs explicit application migration and Discord client credentials support.
